title: Read the secret at run time
claim: The application reads the password from Secrets Manager at run time, so rotation no longer requires updating your applications.
alt: A sequence with four participants: an application, AWS Secrets Manager, AWS KMS and a database. The application asks for the secret, Secrets Manager decrypts it with AWS KMS and returns it, and rotation later changes the password.

messages.label: GetSecretValue
messages.say: The application calls Secrets Manager with its IAM role.

messages.label: Decrypt
messages.say: Secrets Manager decrypts the secret value with AWS KMS.

messages.label: AWSCURRENT
messages.say: Secrets Manager returns the AWSCURRENT version over TLS.

messages.label: Rotate
messages.say: Rotation changes the password in the secret and in the database.

asides.text: Next read gets the new password
